question: Across the original 53 radar stations and spring migration years, does site-level MODIS mean greenup tend to fall before 10%-passage, within the 10%–90% passage window, or after 90%-passage?
purpose: Quantify how crude availability-at-the-median masks the timing of the migrating assemblage, not any new payoff/learning mechanism

source.data_origin: weather radar migrant assemblage + MODIS land-surface phenology; no eBird

primary_population: Exact 828 original complete site-years from PR #415 defined by nonmissing spring_q50,spring_mean_temp,mean_greenup; retain all, do not shrink denominator to only valid q10/q90.
primary_exclusive_classes: GREENUP_BEFORE_Q10: mean_greenup < spring_q10 (strict; the earliest 10% radar-passage quantile occurs later)
tie_rule: At q10 tie allocate to second class, q50 tie to third, q90 tie to third. Numeric tolerance eps=1e-9 d; exact-source precision, no data binning.
missing_policy: Rows outside 1..366 DOY, with absent q10/q90, or with unresolved calendar value enter UNCLASSIFIABLE; report exact k/N to (k+unknown)/N logical identification bounds. Do not drop from N=828, impute, or reinterpret -27.
secondary_descriptive: greenup >=7 days before q10 and >=7 days before q50; 7d is hypothetical, not measured satellite distribution lag
fraction q10 observed before mean greenup (strict)
16 original year aggregate rows, not per-station original records
check original q50 comparison reproduces PR #416
output: Only total counts, logical lower/upper fractions over 828, year aggregate labels, schema/check status, source hashes; never station IDs/lat/lon/site-year original rows
statistical_inference: No p-value, CI, bootstrap, causal effect, conditional response coefficient, or prediction model. Identification bounds are logical finite-sample uncertainty of unknown source field(s) not statistical CIs.
uncertainty_policy: If classifiable <95%, any nonmonotonic observed q10/q50/q90 or original q50 checkpoint differs, output source support failure and no migration-window result.
declared_analysis_order: Source column/row identity checks -> complete-case support -> q10/q50/q90 monotonic gate -> q50 historical checkpoint -> exclusive class calculation -> aggregate bounds/report
limitations: The 10th and 90th percentiles are assemblage radar passage dates, not tracked individuals or the true start and end of the entire season
MODIS mean greenup day is a retrospectively fitted marker and may differ from actual food availability or onset of perceivable environmental information
Even greenup before radar q10 does not prove birds at origin knew it before departure or used it as a cue
Overlapping migration window and greenup does not establish fitness, stopover recourse, partner synchrony or strategic interaction
All observations are from the same public Adams dataset as PRs #415/#416; exploratory after prior outcomes, not external replication
Retrospective climate and greenup measures cannot be described as timestamped forecasts available to birds
